description: On-demand live webcam for the owner's exact Ditoo Plus. The owner launches it; the MCP dashboard (Runtime 003) is suspended for exactly as long as the Studio window is open and restored when it closes. 002: one connection per launch (no session rollover). 003: look preset and palette cap selectable live; Ditoo button press recorded as a Host-confirmed stock yield.

behavior.session_ids: OPENDITOO-WEBCAM-LIVE-<run nonce 8 hex>-<seq 3 digits>, fresh per session, durable one-use claim taken only against the Studio's per-session nonce; the Host ledger independently consumes each id
behavior.stop: Stop button, window close or Ctrl+C end the launch; camera fault, stall, Host refusal/fault, ACK timeout, any unknown outcome, policy revocation or hash drift end it with no retry; one session of at most 30 min per launch
behavior.scheduler: W10 absolute-deadline scheduler, max mode: 50 ms slots, 50 ms client floor over the 40 ms Host streaming floor, missed slots skipped, duplicate/unchanged frames not sent, heartbeat on a quiet scene

Does not start by itself, does not widen the dashboard runtime policy, grants no raw send, target selection, firmware or persistence, and does not revive any W7-W10 experiment grant or WEBCAM-PRODUCT-001/002.
